ATLAS-side docstring edit not in formal-math: the module notes, the problem docstring and the resolution docstring credit P. Dodos, J. Lopez-Abad and S. Todorcevic; the problem and resolution docstrings state the problem for some 0 < eps < 1 (the source asks for some eps > 0, with classical type and cotype; for that classical problem the restriction loses nothing, since every space has type p for 0 < p <= 1 and failing cotype 2 + eps implies failing cotype 2 + eps' for every 0 < eps' < eps, but it is not an equivalence of the Lean predicates, which accept every real exponent: HasType R 0 fails); the module note allows any finite positive moment in Kahane's inequality; and the resolution docstring takes p(X) over 1 <= p <= 2 and q(X) over finite q >= 2 (+infinity if there is none), states cotype monotonicity for positive exponents and paraphrases Remark 7 with its bounded approximation property clause.
